candidate_deployment_domain.eligibility: Same valid native context, finite strictly historical q and original action domain as collection; old empirical q min/max do not exclude a root
candidate_deployment_domain.old_q_range_role: Frozen scaling and an explicit interpolation/extrapolation annotation only; not a confidence interval
candidate_deployment_domain.activation: No deployment in v97. A separately fitted fixed b/u and independently calibrated C must be frozen before any validation; original m<0 AND U<0; at most one intervention then original reference
candidate_deployment_domain.calibration_population: All potentially accepted first-line roots from this same domain in each independent seed block, including old-q-range extrapolation; no selective omission
candidate_deployment_domain.claim: At most the original exchangeability-dependent80% marginal seed-block upper coverage; no per-action or universal no-harm guarantee
candidate_deployment_domain.validation_gate: A real nonzero intervention; mean actual full-day cost improves vs reference and raw history6; no valid scenario worse than reference; stable tail nonpositive; report stale/line3/service5 and worst cell. All-reference is not a benefit.
candidate_deployment_domain.remaining_C_V_seeds: Unchanged sealed v95 C and V cohorts; not collected or exposed in v97
